content_sections.heading: NIELIT Ajmer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIELIT Ajmer Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIELIT Ajmer Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Faculty (CSE): A regular B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering/M.Sc. in Computer Science with First Class from a recognized university. Desirable: M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering. Experience: 1 Year experience After B.Tech and M.Sc. in Computer Science in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. Programming (C, C++, Java, Python) Web development (HTML, CSS, JS, PHP) Computer networks, OS, DBMS Exposure to latest technologies (Cloud, AI/ML basics). Finance Officer: Graduate in Commerce (B.Com) and CA / ICWAI /CS from a recognized University/Institution with working knowledge in Accounting Software such as Tally etc. Intern: Graduate from a recognized University/Institution with 1 year Diploma in Computer Applications Or NIELIT A Level.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Faculty (CSE): Rs. 25000/- to 30000/- Per Month Finance Officer: Rs. 35000/- to 40000/- Per Month Intern: Rs. 10000/- Per Month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIELIT Ajmer Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIELIT Ajmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview. The interview is scheduled for 17 August 2026. Candidates should report to the venue on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NIELIT Ajmer?
faq.answer: NIELIT Ajmer has announced a total of 7 vacancies for various posts, including Faculty (CSE), Finance Officer, and Intern.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Faculty (CSE) post?
faq.answer: For the Faculty (CSE) post, candidates need a regular B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering or M.Sc. in Computer Science with First Class. M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Finance Officer position?
faq.answer: The Finance Officer position offers a salary ranging from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the NIELIT Ajmer recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 250 for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the NIELIT Ajmer located?
faq.answer: NIELIT Ajmer is located in Ajmer, Rajasthan, with the Pincode 305408.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Can a fresher apply for the Faculty (CSE) post?
faq.answer: The Faculty (CSE) post requires 1 year of experience after B.Tech and M.Sc. in Computer Science in specific areas like AI, ML, and Deep Learning, along with programming and web development skills.
